title: Beware Desire
coreMove: Stillness grows when you test a want before obeying it: name the appetite, name its cost, and refuse any desire that needs secrecy to survive.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader reviewing a failure after private appetite damaged public trust
exampleSpecs.stakes: secrecy could be mistaken for a small private matter instead of the decisive break
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open after the failure and locate the one misstep through the trace it left

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who notices their own want changing shape while work is moving
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team need could become a status performance unless the error is caught mid-stream
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: center the moment of noticing her own error before the fix

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader who needs a written artifact to carry the hard call
exampleSpecs.stakes: private appetite could be excused because visible performance remains strong
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: make the memo itself carry the action and the reasoning

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader comparing two ways to handle the same tempting upgrade
exampleSpecs.stakes: one approach multiplies comparison while the other keeps the want tied to the real need
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: give two named people equal weight as their outcomes diverge

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader stuck inside a private want that sounds harmless
exampleSpecs.stakes: a private indulgence may be defended as freedom while it creates fear of exposure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use one conversation to reframe the protagonist's stuck view

exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who confuses every want with selfishness
exampleSpecs.stakes: confusion could turn the lesson into denial instead of discrimination
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: make the learner's confusion the teaching material
